priorities.text: A fair chance for everyone to do well whatever their circumstances

summary.text: Anastasia Sagris-Desmond is standing for Labor in Sandringham, held by the Liberals, at the 2026 Victorian election. She is a psychologist who has practised for over three decades and is bringing up her family in the area. According to the ABC, a board of the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency has approved her as a supervisor, and she has also trained staff in workplaces.

Anastasia Sagris-Desmond, Labor Candidates, Victorian Labor

summary.text: Anthony Blight is One Nation's candidate for Sandringham at the 2026 Victorian election. For close to 15 years he has owned and run a truck-servicing business. The ABC notes that he is a Royal Australian Navy veteran whose working life of over three decades has spanned defence, energy, transport, engineering and infrastructure.

sources.title: Sandringham: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Brad Rowswell has been the Liberal MP for Sandringham since 2018 and was re-elected in 2022. Before Parliament he was a political adviser and a communications manager at Raytheon. He held the Shadow Treasurer role between late 2022 and early 2025, and since November 2025 has been Shadow Minister for Education, Industrial Relations and Government Services. He is recontesting Sandringham in 2026.

summary.text: Lauren Stevenson is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Sandringham at the 2026 Victorian election. She has lived in the area for more than 20 years and has worked in the public service for the past four, where she is a workplace delegate for the Community and Public Sector Union. On the party's site she describes 15 years of activism, including union and student campaigns and anti-war protests.

summary.text: Timon Fotakis is the Greens candidate for Sandringham at the 2026 Victorian election. He has lived in the area all his life and is a Monash University student, and he has worked as a labourer, in a warehouse and as a researcher. His campaign centres on public schools, public transport and transparency in government.
